does_not_cover: Never runs a numeric full-network update: no concrete weights, no worked epoch, no code.
Deep-learning practice missing: no architecture choice, no overfitting, no optimizer tuning.
Activation functions only named in passing: no comparison, no gradient plots, no failure cases.
notes: Dense fast notation; assumes the prior intuition video and basic derivatives. Cost-averaging over examples only sketched — thin on training-loop practice.

segments.topic: Goal and scope: calculus view of backpropagation after the intuition part
Single-neuron layers: weights, biases, cost and the z notation
Chain-rule split of cost sensitivity into three ratios
Derivative values, bias shortcut and tracking back to earlier layers
Multiple neurons per layer: indices, shared paths and summed influences
Closing: gradient pieces for downhill cost minimization
